title: 第15章 揭幕战第16章 一帽惊人
content_zh:
第十五章 揭幕战
叶锋说的是由漫画改编的电影《刺客联盟》，本片最大的特色是甩枪，打出的子弹能拐弯。
“你觉得我能演功夫片？”加布瑞拉从来没往这方面想过。
叶锋看着她，微笑道：“好莱坞永远也不会放弃拍摄动作电影，你平时常练瑜伽，柔韧性很好，当然能演动作片。高难度动作都是经过后期处理的，只要会摆POSS就行。不然你以为人人都是成龙、李连杰吗？安吉丽娜.朱莉年龄太大，身体瘦的吓人，她只是靠名气来赚票房。连卡梅隆.迪亚兹和巴里摩尔都可以演霹雳娇娃，你为什么不可以？你的身高接近180CM，运动能力不会太差，动作片对你来说就是最简单的一条路。将来等成名了再走文艺爱情片路线，人们反而会称赞你的演技。爱情片导演都会想要找年龄偏大的演员，哪怕是不出名的新人，也会用23岁以上的，那些人能演出生活阅历丰的角色，你一看就是邻家女孩儿。”
加布瑞拉靠叶锋近了一点，问道：“想出演大片很难啊，电视剧你感觉有适合我的吗？”
“有不少，我想想。”
叶锋随口说出了几部美剧《超感神探》，《犯罪心理》，《迷失》，《别对我撒谎》等，都是收视率比较高的。电影方面，他就提到了《刺客联盟》，《金刚狼》，建议她看过漫画后去试试。
在叶锋前世，《刺客联盟》的女主角是安吉丽娜.朱莉，片子里她看起来像是男主角的阿姨，而且暴瘦，双臂似树杈，显出青筋，给人的感觉不是性感，而是像吸毒者。据传闻导演也希望能启用新人，只是没有合适的对象才选择了她。叶锋觉得如果年轻的加布瑞拉在路上和人飙车，打出拐弯的子弹，肯定更有看头。
两人在阳台聊了很久，话题从电影说到篮球，又说到家庭，直到人走光派对结束，他们的关系不知不觉拉近了。
2007－2008NBA常规赛揭幕战湖人将主场迎战姚明、麦迪领衔的休斯顿火箭队。自从姚麦凑在一起，火箭就成为了联盟一支强队，专家们每年都视他们为夺冠热门，不过他们连续两次季后赛在2－0领先的情况下最终以3－4输掉系列赛。姚明正在巅峰期，收拾拜纳姆很轻松。健康的麦迪也是全面的得分手，没有任何球队敢小看姚麦组合。
叶锋本以为难有出场机会，没想到首场就进入了12人大名单。米姆、图里亚夫、克里坦顿被放在了伤病名单中。其中图里亚夫是真的有伤在身，季前赛扭伤了脚踝。米姆也是以防守见长，教练组最终选择了运动能力更强，能防多个位置的叶锋。虽然进攻端他只能靠扣篮，但是只要参与快攻，还是有得分能力的。
加布瑞拉对篮球没有太高的热情，听叶锋说不会上场很长时间后，决定留在家里看电视。两人现在都不富裕，叶锋稍好一些，在拿到薪水前也要适当节俭，他在湖人地位并不牢固，要为在一月份前不被裁掉而努力。
10月31日，斯台普斯球馆座无虚席，两万名观众涌入球馆观看这场比赛。ESPN对比赛进行了直播，巴克利和史密斯这对金牌搭档又来到了现场。
比赛开始前，“大嘴”巴克利又开始调侃科比，连麦迪也一起黑上了。“今年夏天科比一直闹转会，不知道球迷会不会虚他。我认为科比和麦迪很像，不管是打法还是机遇，他们都得过两次得分王，独立带队时他们都没有突破季后赛第一轮，都在3比1领先的情况被对手翻盘，在最关键的第七场都选择了提前放弃比赛。唯一的不同是，科比没有在3比1领先时说：我已经准备打第二轮了。”
史密斯笑道：“现在麦迪的运气比科比好一些，他身边有了姚明这位全明星中锋，今天湖人怎么限制姚明的发挥是关键。”
巴克利笑道：“科比现在身边也有个中国人，媒体说这场比赛是中国德比，不过本场比赛叶锋大概只能看守饮水机。”
巴克利说的是事实，叶锋热身后坐在了替补席上，旁边就是饮水机。
火箭首发阵容和上赛季完全相同：姚明、海耶斯、巴蒂尔、麦迪、阿尔斯通。湖人排上拜纳姆、奥多姆、拉德马诺维奇、科比、费舍尔。
双方都不缺乏球星，比赛开始后却都不在状态，你来我往疯狂打铁，打了近四分钟，才由科比急停跳投命中了本场比赛第一球。之后他在一次反击中造成巴蒂尔犯规，两罚全中，为湖人取得4－0开局，火箭却是7投全失迈出了新季第一步。
姚明此后连得5分，可火箭整体打的毫无章法，前13次出手只有姚明命中了2球，科比卯足了劲贴身防守麦迪，使得麦迪首节6投1中，打满首节的科比单节就拿下13分，带领湖人25－16领先。姚明是火箭唯一发挥正常的，连投带罚球拿下了9分。

第二节双方都换上了替补阵容，风云突变。阿德尔曼派出了邦奇.威尔斯与迈克.詹姆斯，威尔斯是个刺头，范甘迪时期不受重用，可他的砍分能力很强，2006年季后赛六场曾在马刺身上场均砍下20+10的明星数据。詹姆斯也是个乱战高手，2006年常规赛场均20.3分5.8助攻。这两人频繁冲击内线，取得了立竿见影的效果，加上巴蒂尔的外线三分，火箭打出13－4冲击波，将比分扳为29平。此节后段双方重新派上主力对抗，半场时战为43平。
第三节火箭气势更胜，姚明单打保持着成功率，麦迪也找回了手感，单节拿下14分，内突外投拉开了比分。科比这一节却熄火了，火箭70－62领先结束第三节。
看到湖人落后，巴克利笑的特别开心，一副欠揍的模样，全然不顾这是湖人的主场。他笑道：“今天火箭打的很乱，我们从前三节看不出他们和上赛季有什么区别，进攻主要靠姚明、麦迪个人单打。阿德尔曼的普林斯顿战术还看不见踪影，不过湖人打的更差，只靠科比一个人，如果不是科比获得了大量的罚球机会，恐怕现在就变成垃圾时间了，三节他已经获得了18次罚球。”
叶锋空有一腔热血却没有用武之地，唯有看着队友在场上拼杀，默默等待机会。
大前锋位置，奥多姆下场后总是换上布莱恩.库克，在第二节和第三节库克都上场了一段时间，教练希望他能投中三分，可他这场手感很烂，4投0中，即使如此，叶锋还是稳稳的坐在场下，拜纳姆下场更轮不到他，杰克逊不会让他去防姚明。
为什么不用我呢？库克这废物频繁漏人，简直就是卧底，看来今天我只能当观众了，第四节，他们更没理由派我上场。叶锋郁闷的想着，他真想主动要求上场，他有信心在防挡拆方面做的比库克好，在他眼中，麦迪的突破比走快不了多少，上篮时都有可能被吹三秒违例，他是绝对不会让麦迪突破成功的。
火箭队第四节最多的时候领先14分，关键时刻科比终于发飙，连得6分，带领湖人打出一波10比2的冲击波，顽强的把比分追了回来。外界经常评价说巴蒂尔是“科比终结者”，可今天巴蒂尔的防守并不奏效，看不到任何终结者的影子。
关于这个说法，叶锋也很疑惑。上赛季火箭两次对阵湖人，科比都在巴蒂尔的防守下砍下了50+的得分。这场第四节没打完，科比也已经得到了38分。巴蒂尔擅长的是在对手投篮的时候封眼干扰。叶锋也这样防过科比一，几乎没任何作用，联盟里很多超级得分手投篮手感很好，就算眼睛不看篮筐，只要在自己熟悉的位置出手，用多大力气都心中有数。巴蒂尔今天被科比完爆。
比赛还剩2分17秒结束，湖人队将比分追平了。阿德尔曼眼见煮熟的鸭子要飞，赶紧请求了暂停。叶锋忽然觉得场面似曾相识。前世湖人和火箭首场比赛也是打到了最后，巴蒂尔投进了三分准绝杀。这一次，还会发生同样的事吗？
比赛重新开始，叶锋继续看比赛。“禅师”杰克逊朝他招了招手，让他坐到自己身边来。他赶忙到了杰克逊面前问道：“教练，什么事？”
杰克逊表情严肃。“叶，你进行一下热身，如果打到最后需要防他们一次进攻话，我会派你上场，我需要你做好防守工作。”
不会吧？他竟然准备这个节骨眼派我上场？叶锋一愣，很快想明白了原因，3号位拉德马诺维奇和沃顿防守都不怎么样，如果最后让他上场，湖人的防守会更好。
杰克逊是名经验老道的教练，新人在第四节容易犯错，但叶锋是内线球员中脚步移动最快的，可以很好的补防外线突破，只是防守，他相信叶锋不会出什么错。
比赛还剩13秒结束，双方打成了92平，火箭队握有球权，请求了暂停。
叶锋知道自己的机会来了。

Chapter 15 Opening Game
Ye Feng is talking about the movie "League of Assassins" adapted from the comic book. The biggest feature of this movie is that the bullet can be deflected by the gun.
"Do you think I can act in a kung fu movie?" Gabriella had never thought about it.
Ye Feng looked at her and smiled: "Hollywood will never give up on making action movies. You often practice yoga and are very flexible, so of course you can act in action movies. The difficult movements are all post-processed, as long as you can do POSS. Otherwise, do you think everyone is Jackie Chan or Jet Li? Angelina Jolie is too old and frighteningly thin. She just relies on her fame to make money at the box office. Even Cameron Diaz and Barrymore can play Thunderbolt. Girl, why can't you? Your height is close to 180cm, and your athletic ability is not bad. Action movies are the easiest way for you. In the future, when you become famous, people will praise your acting skills. Romance movie directors will want to find older actors, even if they are unknown newcomers, who can play roles with rich life experience, and you will look like the girl next door. "
Gabriella leaned a little closer to Ye Feng and asked, "It's difficult to star in a blockbuster movie. Do you think there is a TV series that is suitable for me?"
"There are quite a few, let me think about it."
Ye Feng casually mentioned several American dramas such as "The Detective", "Criminal Minds", "Lost", "Lie to Me", etc., all of which have relatively high ratings. As for movies, he mentioned "Assassins" and "Wolverine" and suggested that she try them after reading the comics.
In Ye Feng's previous life, the heroine of "League of Assassins" was Angelina Jolie. In the film, she looked like the male protagonist's aunt. She was also very thin, her arms were like tree branches, and her veins were visible. She gave the impression that she was not sexy, but like a drug addict. According to rumors, the director also hoped to cast a newcomer, but he chose her because there was no suitable candidate. Ye Feng felt that it would be more interesting if the young Gabriella raced with others on the road and shot round corners.
The two chatted for a long time on the balcony, and the topics ranged from movies to basketball to family. Until the party ended, their relationship unknowingly grew closer.
The Lakers will face the Houston Rockets led by Yao Ming and Tracy McGrady at home in the opening game of the 2007-2008 NBA regular season. Since Yao and Mai came together, the Rockets have become a strong team in the league. Experts regard them as the favorites to win the championship every year. However, they ended up losing the series 3-4 after leading 2-0 in two consecutive playoffs. Yao Ming is in his prime, and it is easy to deal with Bynum. A healthy Tracy McGrady is also a comprehensive scorer. No team dares to underestimate the Yao-Mai combination.
Ye Feng originally thought it would be difficult to get a chance to play, but he did not expect to be included in the 12-man roster in the first game. Mihm, Turiaf, and Crittenton were placed on the injured list. Among them, Turiaf is really injured. He sprained his ankle in the preseason. Mim is also good at defense, so the coaching staff finally chose Ye Feng, who is more athletic and can defend multiple positions. Although he can only rely on dunks on the offensive end, he is still capable of scoring as long as he participates in fast breaks.
Gabriella didn't have much enthusiasm for basketball. After hearing from Ye Feng that he wouldn't play for a long time, she decided to stay at home and watch TV. Neither of them is rich now. Ye Feng is slightly better off and must be frugal before getting his salary. His position in the Lakers is not solid and he must work hard not to be laid off before January.
On October 31, Staples Arena was packed with 20,000 spectators pouring into the arena to watch the game. ESPN broadcast the game live, and the gold medal pair of Barkley and Smith came to the scene again.
Before the game started, "Big Mouth" Barkley started teasing Kobe again, and even Tracy McGrady also took advantage of him. "Kobe has been in trouble for a transfer this summer. I don't know if the fans will be disappointed with him.". I think Kobe and Tracy McGrady are very similar. Whether it’s play style or opportunities, they both won two scoring titles. When they led the team independently, they both failed to break through the first round of the playoffs. They were both overturned by their opponents when leading 3-1. In the most critical seventh game, they both chose to give up the game early. The only difference is that Kobe didn't say when he was leading 3-1: I'm ready to play in the second round. "
Smith smiled and said: "Now McGrady has better luck than Kobe. He has the All-Star center Yao Ming next to him. How the Lakers limit Yao Ming's performance today is the key. "
Barkley smiled and said: "Kobe has a Chinese next to him now. The media said this game is a Chinese derby, but Ye Feng can probably only guard the water dispenser in this game. "
What Barkley said was true. After Ye Feng warmed up, he sat on the bench next to the water dispenser.
The Rockets' starting lineup is exactly the same as last season: Yao Ming, Hayes, Battier, Tracy McGrady, and Alston. The Lakers lined up Bynum, Odom, Radmanovic, Kobe and Fisher.
There was no shortage of stars on both sides, but neither side was in their best form after the game started. They went back and forth like crazy, and after nearly four minutes of play, Kobe Bryant hit the first shot of the game with a pull-up jumper. Later, he caused Battier to foul during a counterattack and made two free throws, giving the Lakers a 4-0 start. However, the Rockets missed all 7 shots and took the first step of the new season.
Yao Ming scored 5 points in a row after that, but the Rockets played disorganized as a whole. Only Yao Ming hit 2 goals in the first 13 shots. Kobe Bryant worked hard to defend McGrady, making McGrady 1 of 6 in the first quarter. Kobe, who played the entire first quarter, scored 13 points in a single quarter, leading the Lakers 25-16. Yao Ming was the only Rocket who performed normally, scoring 9 points with consecutive free throws.
In the second quarter, both sides put on substitute lineups, and the situation suddenly changed. Adelman sent Bunch Wells and Mike James. Wells was a thorn in the side and was not reused during the Van Gundy period, but he was very capable of scoring. In the six games of the 2006 playoffs, he averaged 20+10 points per game for the Spurs. James is also a master of chaos, averaging 20.3 points and 5.8 assists per game in the 2006 regular season. The two frequently attacked the inside and achieved immediate results. Coupled with Battier's outside three-pointer, the Rockets hit a 13-4 shock wave and tied the score at 29. In the latter part of this quarter, the two sides returned to their main force to fight, and the battle was tied at 43 at halftime.
In the third quarter, the Rockets were even more powerful. Yao Ming maintained his success rate in singles, and McGrady also found his touch. He scored 14 points in a single quarter, shooting inside and outside to open up the score. Kobe stalled in this quarter, and the Rockets ended the third quarter with a 70-62 lead.
Seeing the Lakers falling behind, Barkley smiled very happily, looking like he needed a beating, completely ignoring that this was the Lakers' home court. He laughed and said: "The Rockets played very chaotically today. From the first three quarters, we couldn't see any difference between them and last season. The offense mainly relied on the individual singles of Yao Ming and Tracy McGrady. There is no trace of Adelman's Princeton tactics, but the Lakers played even worse, relying on Kobe alone. If Kobe hadn't gotten a lot of free throw opportunities, it might have become garbage time now. He had already got 18 free throws in the three quarters. "
Ye Fengkong had a lot of passion but no place to put it to use. He could only watch his teammates fight on the court and silently wait for opportunities.
At the power forward position, Odom always replaced Brian Cook after he came off the court. Cook played for a period of time in the second and third quarters. The coach hoped that he could hit a three-pointer, but his touch was very bad this time, shooting 0 for 4. Even so, Ye Feng still sat firmly on the court. Bynum was not in his turn after the game, and Jackson would not let him guard Yao Ming.
Why not use me? Cook, a loser, frequently misses people and is almost an undercover agent. It seems that I can only be a spectator today. In the fourth quarter, they have no reason to send me on the court. Ye Feng thought depressedly, he really wanted to take overHe is confident that he can do a better job than Cook in preventing pick-and-rolls. In his eyes, McGrady's breakthrough is not much faster than walking. He may be called for a three-second violation during a layup. He will never let McGrady succeed in breaking through.
The Rockets led by 14 points at the most in the fourth quarter. At the critical moment, Kobe finally got angry and scored 6 points in a row, leading the Lakers to a 10-2 shock wave and tenaciously chasing the score back. The outside world often comments that Battier is the "Kobe Bryant Terminator", but today Battier's defense is not effective, and there is no sign of a terminator.
Regarding this statement, Ye Feng was also very confused. The Rockets faced the Lakers twice last season, and Kobe scored 50+ points both times under Battier's defense. Before the fourth quarter of this game was finished, Kobe had already scored 38 points. What Battier is good at is blocking his eyes to interfere with his opponent's shots. Ye Feng also defended Kobe Bryant in this way, with almost no effect. Many super scorers in the league have good shooting touch. Even if they don't look at the basket, as long as they take the shot from a familiar position, they know how hard to use it. Battier was completely blown away by Kobe today.
The game ended with 2 minutes and 17 seconds left, and the Lakers tied the score. Seeing that the cooked duck was about to fly, Adelman quickly requested a timeout. Ye Feng suddenly felt that the scene seemed familiar. The first game between the Lakers and Rockets in the previous life also went to the end. Battier made a three-pointer that was sure to win. Will the same thing happen this time?
The game restarted and Ye Feng continued to watch the game. "Zen Master" Jackson waved to him and asked him to sit next to him. He hurried to Jackson and asked, "Coach, what's the matter?"
Jackson looked serious. "Ye, you warm up. If you need to defend against their attack at the end of the game, I will send you on the field. I need you to do a good job of defense."
No way? He is actually planning to send me on stage at this critical moment? Ye Feng was stunned and quickly figured out the reason. Neither Radmanovic nor Walton at No. 3 was very good defensively. If he was allowed to play in the end, the Lakers' defense would be better.
Jackson is an experienced coach. Newcomers are prone to making mistakes in the fourth quarter, but Ye Feng is the fastest moving player among the inside players and can defend against outside breakthroughs very well. He only believes that Ye Feng will not make any mistakes.
The game ended with 13 seconds left and the two sides were tied at 92. The Rockets had the ball and requested a timeout.
Ye Feng knew his chance had come.
